label_status: PROVISIONAL; independent review required before using as production selection evidence
source: 32 legacy development cases plus 38 new development cases; 30 holdout cases kept private

schema_policy.intent: Literal user constraints only; do not derive specifications from model identifiers. Use separate catalog enrichment.
schema_policy.negative_conditions: Use excluded_conditions; not refurbished is not synonymous with new only.
schema_policy.tool: First-action tool choice; search before product details unless previous search results exist.
schema_policy.grounding: Verified landed total = price + shipping + tax - verified coupon; missing fields invalidate total.
schema_policy.matching: Same sellable variant requires compatible identifiers, capacity, size, color, condition, region, year.
schema_policy.safety: Never execute purchase/payment or store raw card details; require exact-offer approval.

original_32_results: Historical results must not be compared as identical scoring condition with v2.
notes: No actual retailer prices are asserted; all offers are synthetic fixtures.
No API calls are performed by the dataset builder or validator.
Some negative-condition prompts need careful interpretation; labels must be signed off by DS and Lead Engineer.
